correctness.rationale: Subtracting the centroid gives a stable linear equation, whose stationary pullback is exactly the centered projection of iid isotropic filtered orientations Z_k. On the dimensionless time scale the first angular mode decays at rate alpha and the second at alpha (RTP) or 4 alpha (ABP). In the mixed-moment recursion, F(1,1,0)=1/(1+alpha), F(2,0,-2)=2/[(1+alpha)(2+alpha*g(2))], and F(2,2,0)=[2F(1,1,0)+F(2,0,-2)]/(3+alpha), giving both fourth moments. In expanding each squared norm, the covariance of the diagonal terms is (m4-m2²) sum a_k² b_k². Centering and independence kill all diagonal/off-diagonal and unmatched pair terms, and each matched pair has E[(Z_k·Z_l)²]=m2²/2. This proves the stated fourth-order contraction. Distinct projection rows have inner product -1/N and sum of squared coordinate products (2N-3)/N³. Substitution and the positive denominators give the signs: delta_N≤0 for N=2,3, and for N≥4 the ABP numerator has one positive root and equals -6 delta_N²-3 delta_N at the positive RTP root. At N=4, alpha=R=1 the covariances are 1/384 and -1/1536; this check is exact and does not require the submitted script. The nontrivial scaled limiting profile is at fixed dimensionless persistence, not at fixed microscopic coupling as N varies.
